# Report Templates

This directory contains reusable report templates for Instagram competitor intelligence workflows.

The templates help users turn workflow outputs into client-ready or team-ready deliverables.

## Template Index

| Template | Best For | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agency Weekly Report | Agencies, freelance marketers, client reporting teams | Client-ready weekly competitor report |
| DTC Brand Report | DTC brands, Shopify stores, cross-border ecommerce teams | Internal competitor monitoring report |
| Reels Breakdown Template | Social media operators, content teams | Top Reels analysis and content ideas |
| Hashtag Trend Template | Content strategists, social media managers | Hashtag frequency and theme summary |
| Creator Mention Research Template | Influencer marketing teams, brand researchers | Public creator / brand mention notes |
| Executive Summary Template | Founders, managers, clients | Short decision-focused summary |
| Service Delivery Checklist | Service providers and agencies | Delivery workflow checklist |

## Recommended Starting Point

If you are using this project for client reports, start with:

```text
docs/templates/agency-weekly-report.md
```

If you are using it for internal brand monitoring, start with:

```text
docs/templates/dtc-brand-report.md
```

If you want to turn generated CSV output into a spreadsheet workflow, see:

```text
docs/integrations/google-sheets.md
```

## Public-Data Boundary

These templates are designed for public-data reporting workflows.

They should not be used for:

- private account monitoring
- Instagram password collection
- automated likes, follows, comments, or DMs
- fake engagement
- spam workflows
- private contact scraping
- claims of official affiliation with Instagram, Meta, or any provider
